issues.extracted: 13 nonmajor funds recorded fund by fund
issues.on_page: Schedule 2 combining schedule, 13 fund columns + Total Nonmajor Special Revenue Funds (pp10-12)
issues.issue: The extractor rule for a combining schedule with more than 6 fund columns says to use its Total column with fund = 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'. Per-fund lines were recorded instead. Every figure is correct and they tie to the Total column (revenue 1,066,478; spending 1,469,487), but this departs from the rule.

585,306 (82%) of this comes from the Health Insurance Fund (p4), probably employee/retiree premium contributions or reimbursements. The page doesn't say what it is, and the printed label is Miscellaneous, so other is defensible.

issues.on_page: Keno Lottery Fund Charges for Services 60,525
issues.issue: Charges for services in a Keno Lottery fund are probably gross keno receipts (the Waverly ruling puts those in keno/lottery). The page labels them Charges for Services, so this is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Visitor's Promotion Intergovernmental 278,619 (also Visitor's Improvement 280,619, detail[48])
issues.issue: These are probably county lodging tax remitted by the state. They are kept as printed ('Intergovernmental'), which is consistent with the printed-label-over-fund-name rule, but the user may want to settle this.

issues.on_page: P&M Register of Deeds Charges for Services 7,379
issues.issue: Register of Deeds preservation and modernization receipts are recording fees, which could be Fees of Office.

issues.extracted: General Fund 'Taxes' 5,523,201 split into Property Taxes 5,091,460 + Motor Vehicle Tax 431,741
issues.on_page: Exhibit F Taxes 5,523,201 (p5); Exhibit D General column Property Taxes 5,091,460, Motor Vehicle Tax 431,741 (p4)
issues.issue: The split is valid: there is a printed breakdown of the same fund's money, it adds exactly, and the labels are the printed rows. The final budget 5,432,888 is not carried to either piece (budget_final null). Noted for the review list only.
